articles.title: Congress seeks probe into MP liquor tender allegations
articles.description: In a letter to Chief Minister Mohan Yadav, Patwari demanded an audit of major liquor tenders in 33 districts from 2012-13 to 2026-27 and sought disclosure of the complete bidding and selection process.

articles.title: No delay this Pongal; dhotis, saris to reach ration cardholders on time: TN minister M Vijay Balaji
articles.description: Following the Tamil Nadu government's approval to continue the free distribution of dhotis and saris to ration cardholders for Pongal next year, production under the scheme will begin soon, with the tender process completed, Minister M Vijay Balaji said on Saturday (August 22).
